title: ARS Coding Record
description: JSONL record schema for one brand-response event in the AI Recommendation Share (ARS) study. One object per line; one object per brand-response event. See PROTOCOL.md (D10) for full field definitions and recording rules. Conditional constraints are enforced via allOf/if/then keyed on class_code (see D10 section 10.3a).

response_id.description: Unique identifier for the AI response (one per response). Must exist in data/responses.jsonl.

question_id.description: Unique identifier for the Market Question Cell (buyer-intent question + stated needs).

platform.description: The AI platform that produced the response.

brand.description: Canonical brand name; aliases and acronyms resolved per R-DP.1.

class_code.description: C1 Mention; C2 Neutral inclusion; C3 Positive consideration; C4 Qualified recommendation; C5 Ranked recommendation; C6 Rejection or warning; ADJUDICATE = no rule resolved, flagged per R-DP.9.

subtype.description: Recorded for C4 and C5 only (R-F.1). For C5, always 'explicit' (R-F.1a). For C1/C2/C3/C6/ADJUDICATE, null (R-F.6).

strength.description: Ordinal recommendation force per R-F.4. 5=C5 rank1 overall; 4=C5 rank2 overall; 3=C5 rank>=3 or category winner (R-F.7); 2=C4 explicit; 1=C4 implicit. null for C1/C2/C3/C6/ADJUDICATE (R-F.6).

final_choice.description: true for the single winning brand; false for others; null for all when no winner (R-FC.3, R-FC.4). Response-level consistency per R-FC.5 (enforced by validation/validate.py E2). null for ADJUDICATE events (R-F.6).

evidence_span.description: Verbatim substring of the response supporting the code (R-F.8). No paraphrase. Must be a substring of the response's full_text (enforced by validation/validate.py E4).

rank_position.description: Integer >=1 for C5 only (R-F.11); null otherwise. Category winners record rank_position=1 within their category (R-F.13).

sponsored.description: true if the appearance is inside a disclosed sponsored block (R-F.15). Does not alter classification.

platform_self_id.description: true if the brand being classified IS the AI platform (or same-vendor product) and the response discloses it (R-F.14). Response-level disclosures naming no classified brand go in the response record's self_disclosure object instead.

rationale.description: Cites rule IDs (e.g., 'R-C4.3'); notes secondary evidence spans and category names where applicable. For ADJUDICATE, must cite R-DP.9 and name candidate codes (R-F.6).

coder_id.description: Unique per coder. Humans prefixed 'human-', LLMs 'llm-' (R-L.4).

protocol_version.description: Semantic version of the coding protocol under which the event was coded (D11).

allOf.description: C1/C2/C3/C6: subtype, strength, rank_position must be null (R-F.1, R-F.4, R-F.11).
C4: subtype must be explicit or implicit (R-F.1); strength exactly 2 if explicit, exactly 1 if implicit (R-F.4); rank_position must be null (R-F.11).
C4 implicit: strength exactly 1; rank_position null (R-F.4, R-F.11).

C5 rank 1: subtype must be explicit (R-F.1a); strength 5 for overall winner or 3 for category winner (R-F.4, R-F.7). The schema permits both because rank_position=1 alone cannot distinguish overall from category; the validator's W1 warning and rationale review disambiguate.
C5 rank 2: subtype explicit (R-F.1a); strength exactly 4 (R-F.4).
C5 rank >= 3: subtype explicit (R-F.1a); strength exactly 3 (R-F.4, R-F.7).
C5 with null rank_position: not permitted per R-F.11 (rank_position must be integer >= 1 for C5).
ADJUDICATE: subtype, strength, rank_position, final_choice must be null (R-F.6).
